title: Data Scientist - Customer Analytics
description:
DATA SCIENTIST - CUSTOMER ANALYTICS

London (Hybrid, 2 days per week) | Up to £65,000

Looking to broaden your data science experience across multiple industries? This is an opportunity to join a specialist analytics consultancy delivering end-to-end modelling projects for well-known organisations across sectors. You'll combine hands-on data science with stakeholder engagement, working on projects that have real commercial impact.

The Company

They are a growing data and analytics consultancy with a strong focus on predictive modelling and customer analytics. With a collaborative team of experienced data professionals, they deliver advanced solutions using modern cloud and data platforms. Their project-based environment offers excellent exposure to a wide range of business challenges and industries.

The Role

  • Develop predictive models to solve customer and commercial challenges
  • Deliver projects across forecasting, customer segmentation, propensity modelling, and pricing analytics
  • Build solutions using Python, SQL, Azure, and Databricks
  • Present model outputs and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Work closely with clients and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience in data science and model development
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills
  • Experience building predictive, forecasting, segmentation, scorecard, or pricing models
  • Experience working with stakeholders and communicating analytical findings
  • Exposure to Azure and/or Databricks
  • Consultancy experience is beneficial but not essential
  • Strong academic background in a quantitative discipline

What They Offer

  • Salary up to £65,000 depending on experience
  • Hybrid working with 2 days per week in the London office
  • Broad exposure to projects across multiple industries
  • Strong technical environment focused on data science and modelling
  • Clear opportunities for professional development and progression

How to Apply

Apply today to learn more about this Data Scientist opportunity.
